notes.title: Game update bug modification
notes.content:
Thank you for your positive feedback.

This update modifies

1. Because adjusting the environment will lead to negative combat effectiveness.

2. Select and click some events to prompt "wrong expression".

Other problems will be corrected one after another

Thank you for your support

notes.title: 2016.1.16 Game bug checking
notes.content:
Content optimization: at present, some players think that the combat effectiveness in the game will be negative, which is under investigation.

Players who have a bug are welcome to give feedback on the situation of the bug. It helps us to find the cause of the bug faster.

notes.title: 2021.1.15 Content optimization
notes.content:
The purpose of getting resources by clicking is to get resources quickly in the early stage. The imbalance of the values leads to the click becoming the main function.

A small amount of resources are reduced by clicking.

Greatly improve the automatic access to resources.

Note: increasing the intensity and volume of the world will increase the number of automatically acquired materials.



Part of the exploration event is to get a lot of resources when the world is not formed in the early days. The resources obtained by this series of events are very small for the middle and later period. High mortality leads to poor experience. It has been amended.

The death probability of some exploration events is reduced.

Current probability:

Death 20%

Get 80% of resources
